summary: Real Prisma work: blind ticket.update() writes replaced with conditional updateMany compare-and-set predicates (escalatedAt:null, expected status/group/firstResponseAt), a genuine $transaction that claims an escalation and writes its audit row atomically, deterministic SLA deadline/rule selection, fail-closed permissions, and a Next 15 async-params migration. 20 real Vitest tests, count verified. Course is 3,800 words of unbroken prose with no code blocks at all, a wrong model solution for the permission fix, two wrong test counts in VERIFICATION.md, and leftover agent-process jargon about manifests and 'the root agent'.

name: _Organized Desktop/05 Numbered Experiments/ww5
top_fix: Delete the identical 135-word '## Reviewer extension' paragraph from 8 of the 9 files - it is pasted verbatim into all nine (~29% of the 4,198 words) - and fix 07-TRACE-LAB.md, whose headline scenario names approval `apr_acme_1` when `mockApprovals` is an empty array and `cc_acme_1` seeds as DRAFT.
summary: Best-shaped CRUD change in the batch: every authz/tenancy/linkage/lifecycle check moved ahead of the first write in the compensation approval flow, expected-status conditional writes so a second decider loses cleanly, updateStatus narrowed from Partial<CompensationChange> to a Pick of timestamp fields, and approval+compensation+notification+audit wrapped in one serialized snapshot-rollback boundary. 11 tests assert whole-store JSON equality after failures and race two decisions with Promise.allSettled; count verified. Honest that the 'transaction' is in-memory. Undercut by one paragraph repeated nine times, a stray recycled sentence about '.NET tests', and a non-existent trace fixture.

name: _Organized Desktop/05 Numbered Experiments/z1
top_fix: Cut the ~600-line verbatim dump of tests/service-layer.test.ts out of 06-SOLUTIONS-AND-REVIEW.md (2,578 of the course's 5,252 words); replace with 3-4 excerpts plus a pointer, and move the answers out of 05-PRACTICE.md into 06 so the exercises ask for predictions instead of stating them.
summary: Fixes a genuine authorization bug: canTakeWorkflowAction scanned every pending approval, so a sequence-1 approver could act while sequence 0 was current; it now joins request.currentStepIndex with approval.sequence via getCurrentAssignment while preserving delegate and original-assignee authority. Companion fix closes an internal-comment leak in both the comments and timeline DTOs. 16 tests run against the PRODUCTION JSON store in disposable temp dirs with serialized before/after assertions, and Astra shipped the real Node TAP log (16 pass / 0 fail) inside the course folder. Unusually precise limits, including that snapshot equality does not prove no in-memory mutation.

name: _Organized Desktop/05 Numbered Experiments/z3/customer-feedback-board
top_fix: Add code blocks - the course has exactly one in nine files. At minimum show transact() from src/server/store.ts (BEGIN IMMEDIATE + validate + single UPDATE + ROLLBACK), expected(), the 'use server' + post-commit revalidatePath block, and one stale-edit test assertion.
summary: Strongest course in B12. Unsigned identity cookie replaced with generated credentials and signed 30-minute HttpOnly sessions; truncating multi-write JSON store replaced with one validated aggregate committed inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE via node:sqlite, so atomicity holds across independent processes; captured-version optimistic concurrency on every mutating command; vote/follow made desired-state instead of toggles. Teaches atomicity vs optimistic concurrency as separate ideas and proves both (a SQLite trigger aborts the write and a test re-reads the DB; two Node processes race one vote). 59 tests = 43 node:test + 16 Playwright, both counted on disk; 4 real screenshots; VERIFICATION.md volunteers that the first browser run failed and why. Exact setup: Node >=22.16, port 3011, setup refuses to overwrite.

name: _Organized Desktop/05 Numbered Experiments/z3/founder-crm-lite
top_fix: Explain (or better, undo) the undocumented src/modules/auth/session.ts change that turned `import { cookies } from 'next/headers'` into `await import('next/headers')` purely so tsx --test can load the service - the clean fix is extracting the four pure role predicates into auth/policy.ts. Also make eslint.config.mjs meaningful: it enables two rules, drops all Next rules, and eslint-config-next sits unused in devDependencies.
summary: Teaches the check-then-write race exactly right: convertLead used to read the DB outside the serialized queue and then issue five separate saveX calls, so two conversions could both pass the convertedAt check and each build a company/contact/deal/event graph. It now runs one updateCrmDatabase callback that re-reads the lead inside the queue and returns one complete value. Also fixes ownership filtering applied AFTER slice(0,8) and adds target-ownership checks before task/note writes. 5 tests hit the real service modules against a disposable CRM_DB_PATH fixture with Promise.allSettled. Ships the real verification log, byte-exact *-before snapshots, an exit-code-gated PowerShell repro script, and - uniquely in this batch - labels which code snippets are runnable vs illustrative.

name: _Organized Desktop/05 Numbered Experiments/z6
top_fix: Delete the self-referential test in service.regressions.test.ts (it builds `const transaction = vi.fn(...)`, calls it, then asserts that same mock was called once, while its name claims to constrain 'the write path') and write the two real ones Astra already describes in prose: savePage with a page whose stored spaceId differs -> ForbiddenError and zero write calls; tx.pageTag.createMany rejecting -> whole callback rolls back.
summary: Excellent Prisma production change, weak course packaging. Page visibility pushed into the Prisma where clause (visiblePageWhere) so drafts are filtered before take() instead of after; a nested space.pages include that leaked drafts sanitized; savePage now re-parses input and re-reads the page INSIDE $transaction, rejecting a page whose stored spaceId differs from the requested space; slug selection and syncTags moved onto the tx client, with findFirst-then-create tag races replaced by tag.upsert on @@unique([spaceId, name]). Every claim verified against source. But: zero code blocks in all nine files, no DATABASE_URL/db:setup instructions, all cited evidence paths point outside the project and name an earlier run (z6-test-03) than the delivered one (z6-test-05), and the three shipped tests never import savePage.

name: _Organized Desktop/05 Numbered Experiments/z7
top_fix: State the 'paused' question explicitly: filtering job pipeline counts to application.status === 'active' excludes paused applications too, and that is a product decision presented as a defect fix. Also add code blocks to 04-TESTING-AND-DEBUGGING.md, which describes the structuredClone non-mutation pattern and the offset/tie fixture entirely in prose.
summary: Read-side only (no writes, no database), but the best test suite in B12 and the most valuable Next.js-specific lesson: compensationBand was being serialized into the RSC payload for every role and merely hidden by the component, so a restricted user's network response contained the salary - now a conditional key spread, asserted via JSON.stringify and Object.hasOwn across all five roles. Also fixes two lists sorted by their FORMATTED label (right.when.localeCompare puts Dec before Jan) and a highlightedJob read that crashed on an empty dataset. Tests cover two timezone offsets for equal instants, a year boundary, ties, invalid instants, and structuredClone non-mutation of the React.cache-shared dataset. Evidence folder keeps a superseded 4-test log and labels it historical. Pair with a write-side course.

name: _Organized Desktop/05 Numbered Experiments/z9
top_fix: Re-file the chapters: seven of the nine files contain the NEXT chapter's content (01-CODEBASE-MAP.md holds the concepts, 02-CONCEPTS.md holds the worked change, 03-WORKED-CHANGE.md holds testing, 04 holds practice, 05 holds solutions, 06 holds the trace lab, 07 holds the limits), so the README's prescribed reading order delivers material out of sequence. Also fix VERIFICATION.md's 'twelve tests' (there are 15).
summary: Most consequential security fix in the batch, wrapped in the most broken course. The session cookie was base64url(JSON.stringify({userId})) - any user could rewrite it to become admin. Replaced with an opaque crypto.randomUUID handle bound server-side to {userId, expiresAt} with an 8h TTL, real logout revocation and fresh user resolution per request; the login route no longer serializes the handle into its JSON body (with a real POST route regression); the dashboard derives allowed client ids from membership BEFORE counting; hasPermission fails closed. 15 tests, count verified on disk, and the trace-lab figures (420000 outstanding, 240000 paid, 300/90 minutes) all check out against demo state. But seven of nine chapters are misfiled, the same three-link Sources block is pasted into all nine, there is not one code block anywhere, and no evidence logs were shipped into the project.
